Yasuo releases the accumulated wind.

Several soldiers are thrown backward or knocked off balance by the wind.

Yasuo does not continue attacking them.

As soon as the formation breaks, Yasuo turns away and runs deeper into the dark forest.

The camera does not follow him immediately.

He does not turn around immediately.

Only the heavy rainfall and wind through the forest remain.

The word “Murderer” echoes faintly through the trees.

Slowly push the camera toward Yasuo from behind.

He remains motionless for a moment.

Cut to black before he fully turns around.
